structured_output.summary: The only failing item is the harness mapping reverse_proxy_stream_detached.caddyfiletest to ./caddytest/integration/caddyfile_adapt, which has no Go files, so go test reports [setup failed]. Every real package passes (caddytest/integration, modules/caddyhttp, encode, reverseproxy), including the adapt test that reads the new .caddyfiletest from inside caddytest/integration. The same failure would apply to any existing .caddyfiletest file. I made no changes, since the fix is outside my file list.

criteria_notes.note: The caddyfiletest adapts to the expected JSON; verified by the passing adapt test in ./caddytest/integration. The [setup failed] result comes from the directory having no Go package, not from the test content.

replan_request.reason: The harness runs `go test ./caddytest/integration/caddyfile_adapt` for the .caddyfiletest file, but that directory contains only data files and no Go package, so it always reports [setup failed]. The adapt test that consumes these files runs in ./caddytest/integration and passes. Please either have the harness map .caddyfiletest files to ./caddytest/integration (the adapt test there), or allow adding a Go file under caddytest/integration/caddyfile_adapt.
